answer: Each identity must pay a recurring entry toll every epoch: the toll is a sealed, audited work record that expires if not renewed. A newcomer clears thirty audited jobs, escrows 170 units for two epochs, and wins four vouches from veteran peers whose ledgers never overlap. A clone reruns every job and posts fresh collateral, and a disproved job burns it. Since receipts are single-use and endorsers cannot be shared, inherited standing is empty, so every extra puppet costs more than the influence it can ever buy. cipher kernel raven
